🚨 Contract Requirement – AI Governance SME & Lead (US) in Buffalo, NY (4 days Onsite) 
🧑‍💼 Role: AI Governance SME & Lead (US)
📍 Location: Buffalo, NY (4 days Onsite) 
🕒 Type: Fulltime/Permanent 

Job Description:
AI Governance SME & Lead (US)
Responsibility
 - Leads the overall workstream; accountable for the obligation-control-gap map and final roadmap/examiner-readiness report
 - Directs the diagnostic against SR 26-2 and NYDFS AI/model risk requirements, and prioritizes remediation by risk. 

 Required skills:
 - AI/model risk governance frameworks (SR 11-7, SR 26-2), NYDFS 500 series, prior Big Bank or regulator-facing advisory experience, executive stakeholder management, program/RAID tracking. 

If you have suitable candidates available, please reach out to me directly via LinkedIn or email me 📧 Mukesh@zennsoft.com
